ops-ryan: FYI rolled kernel 5.15 -> 6.4 to a small eu-west2 GPU batch (canary), seeing immediate host panics and reboots on some machines. dmesg excerpt from host-usa-03: 

ops-ryan: ```
[  +0.123456] NVRM: GPU at 0000:3b:00.0: rm_init failed: -18
[  +0.123457] nvidia: loading out-of-tree module taints kernel
[  +0.123458] nvidia-uvm: probe of nvidia-uvm failed with error -22
[  +0.123459] kernel: [BUG] unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference at 0000000000000008
[  +0.123460] RIP: 0010:nv_drm_handle_framebuffer+0x2d4/0x4b0
```

sre-oncall: How many hosts affected and which instance types? any CUDA/kernel combo details? :thinking_face:

ops-ryan: So far 6 hosts across p4d and a100 pools in eu-west2 canary. Running CUDA toolkit 12.2, driver 535.101 installed via our driver-ops package (dkms build succeeded on 5.15). On 6.4 the nvidia modules build but `nvidia-uvm` never registers, devices show up empty in `/proc/driver/nvidia/gpus`. Some hosts hard-rebooted, others OOM-kill loops.

eng-kernel: This smells like a kernel ABI change around dma-buf / drm connector callbacks between 5.x and 6.x. I've seen `nv_drm_handle_framebuffer` traces for 6.3+ regressions in other orgs. Can we get a full crash dump? @infra-bot can you capture kdump + `modinfo nvidia` output for the affected nodes?

infra-bot: Collected artifacts for hosts: s3://redwood-artifacts/1785009876/kdumps/ (host-logs.tar.gz), module-info: s3://redwood-artifacts/1785009876/modinfo.txt

ai-systems: We're already seeing user-visible effects: inference p99 latency in eu-west2 spiked ~2.8x and several requests hit fallback models (cpu fallback) — daily hosted inference cost estimate up ~$1.6k extra for the window. Also capacity pressure; autoscaler is draining other pools and we're seeing provisioning delays in us-west.

ops-ryan: To add, one host exhibited NIC rebind/flap after the kernel module unload: `ixgbevf` showing repeated link down/up during module probe. That caused several pods to lose routes briefly. Suspect interplay between pci rescan and vfio device detachment. Avoid mass module unload for rollback.

sre-oncall: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) Pause remaining 6.4 rollouts in eu-west2 and us-west canaries. 2) Start canary rollback to 5.15 on the 8 hosts that haven't been rolled yet. 3) Rollback drivers to pinned 535.92 (packaged) on affected hosts only after kernel downgrade. 4) Collect bisection candidates + kernel config and open vendor bug.

deploy-bot: Initiating rollback play: job=rb-1785009876-01, targets=4 hosts, strategy=serial, notify=#eng-oncall. ETA per host ~10-15m.

eng-platform: Proposal: add a GPU kernel compatibility gate to our rollout pipeline — require smoke test that exercises `nvidia-uvm` + small CUDA job and NIC stress before marking a kernel image healthy. Also disable livepatch auto-apply on GPU pools; apply only after successful canary window. I'll draft a playbook. Link: https://confluence.redwood/gpu-kernel-playbook (WIP).

ops-ryan: Quick workaround for folks who need immediate capacity: spawn from the pre-6.4 AMI in eu-west2 (ami-gpu-5.15-stable). We have 20 spare nodes in the staging pool tagged `eu-west2-standby` — provisioning from that pool avoids draining other regions.

eng-kernel: Action for R&D: reproduce locally with kernel 6.4 + driver 535.101 + CUDA 12.2 on a bridged test VM + synthetic workload hitting drm/cuda concurrently. If we can repro, bisect using 6.3->6.4 patches and open kernel+NVIDIA driver issues.

sre-oncall: Logging incident and severity: sev2. Impact: eu-west2 hosted inference latency & a few dedicated customers affected. Pager rotation: @sre-oncall -> @ops-ryan -> @eng-kernel. Postmortem owners: ops-ryan + eng-platform.

ai-systems: Note on cost — enable short-term cost cap on eu-west2 inference routes to prevent runaway billing from CPU fallback while we stabilize. I'll coordinate with finance for temporary budget increase if needed.

ops-ryan: Will follow up with timeline when rollbacks complete. If anyone sees an odd `PCI` or `dmesg` line not in the artifacts bucket, paste it here. :thumbsup:

eng-platform: Creating the rollout-blocker checklist now. Items: stop kernel pipeline, pin driver packages, schedule full fleet maintenance window, notify customers in impacted region, start bisection with eng-kernel.

sre-oncall: Thanks everyone. Keep this thread as the single source for updates. Next update in ~15m or when rollback job finishes.
